parsedVerdict.reasoning: Both files are domain entities with a shared concern: the core state and invariants of the order-fulfilment domain. Each class keeps its own rules inside itself and exposes guard and mutator pairs in the same style (canTransitionTo/transitionTo and canReserve/reserve). Order owns the order-status rules, and Product owns the stock-reservation rules. Neither file repeats the other's rules. Neither file goes around its own abstractions: transitionTo calls canTransitionTo, and reserve calls canReserve, which calls getAvailableStock. Order refers to products only by productId, so the boundary between the two entities stays clean.
